title: Megiddo and Armageddon
lead: Megiddo guarded the pass where the coastal road crosses into the Jezreel Valley, and great battles were fought near it: Pharaoh Thutmose III's, Deborah's (Judges 5:19) and the one in which King Josiah was killed (2 Kings 23:29; 2 Chronicles 35:22). Revelation's "Armageddon," from Hebrew Har Megiddo, "mountain of Megiddo," is where the kings gather for the last battle (Revelation 16:16).
